{{Quote|I'm called Ceta Farr. I teach these mercenaries how to fight. My service to the Master is a matter of honor.|Ceta Farr|<ref name="TOR:Pilgrimage" />}}
'''Ceta Farr''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who was a member of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] cult known as the [[Order of Revan|Revanites]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the War, she lived near [[Kaas City]] on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], where she trained other Mandalorian warriors. In secret, she helped initiate new members into the the Revanites by giving them tasks on their Pilgrimage, the name given to the final task Revanite initiates undertook before being accepted or rejected from the cult.<ref name="TOR:Pilgrimage" />
